items.title: fix(server): clear restart-orphaned pending-elicitation count on answer
items.body:
## Related issue

Resolves [OMNI-5946](https://linear.app/omnigent/issue/OMNI-5946/multiagent-needs-response-stuck-user-answers-never-register-polly)

## Summary

ELI5: a sub-agent asked you a question, so the sidebar showed a "Needs
response" badge. The little helper that was waiting for your answer crashed and
the app restarted. After that, answering the question did nothing — the badge
stayed lit forever.

The badge is driven by `pending_elicitation_count`, which lives in two places: a
per-replica in-memory index and a persisted mirror on the conversation row (so
the count survives across replicas and restarts). When a sub-agent's transient
runner dies (SIGTERM / exit 143) and never reconnects, and the serving replica
then restarts, the in-memory index is wiped while the persisted count survives.
Answering goes through `pending_elicitations.resolve()`, which early-returns
against the now-empty index, so it never fires the count-persist hook. The
per-runner reconcile in `_on_runner_connect` only runs when that runner comes
back — which it never does — so the orphaned persisted count, and the badge,
stay stuck at 1.

The fix: after forwarding an answer in `_resolve_elicitation`, when no runner
tunnel is reachable, persist the authoritative live count
(`pending_elicitations.count_for(session_id)`). That clears a restart-orphaned
badge on answer. When a runner *is* reachable it is left untouched — its own
tunnel-holding replica remains the authoritative writer, so this never clobbers
a live runner's count.

## Test Plan

Verified against the current PR head (branch brought up to date with `main`;
all commands run from the PR checkout with repository test dependencies
installed):

- `tests/server/test_resolve_reconciles_orphaned_pending_count.py` — unit
  coverage of the three branches of the new reconcile (offline runner + empty
  index → persist 0; offline runner + a still-live sibling prompt → persist the
  authoritative live count 1, not a blind zero; reachable runner → do not
  reconcile). 3 passed.
- `tests/e2e_ui/approvals/test_needs_response_clears_after_restart.py` —
  end-to-end: spawns a real server + runner, parks a real claude-native
  `permission-request`, SIGTERMs the runner (exit 143), restarts the server
  against the same durable SQLite store, answers via the resolve endpoint, and
  asserts the sidebar badge source clears. Confirmed fail→pass on this tree:
  without the fix it fails with `pending_elicitations_count=1`; with the fix it
  passes.
- The server integration reproduction
  (`tests/server/integration/test_sessions_elicitation_resolve_url.py::test_resolve_clears_needs_response_orphaned_by_replica_restart`)
  — confirmed fail→pass on this head (fails `assert 1 == 0` on the unfixed tree,
  passes with the fix).
- Regression sweep of the shared code paths: the full
  `test_sessions_elicitation_resolve_url.py` suite (22 passed) and the
  `pending_elicitations` / `session_live_state` / terminal- and antigravity-
  elicitation suites (108 passed) — no regressions.
- `pre-commit` lint clean on the diff (ruff check + format, the
  `session-list-visibility` project rule, and `pyrefly` type-check of the
  changed product code).

```bash
python -m pytest \
  tests/e2e_ui/approvals/test_needs_response_clears_after_restart.py \
  tests/server/test_resolve_reconciles_orphaned_pending_count.py -q
```

This revision also brings the branch current with `main` and fixes the
pre-commit failures that were blocking the earlier head (`contextlib.suppress`
for the parked-request error, ruff formatting, and an explicit `visibility=all`
on the sidebar `/v1/sessions` read).

## Demo

- [ ] Visual demo attached below
- [x] Non-visual evidence provided below or in Test Plan
- [ ] Not applicable — no behavioral change

none — The corrected outcome is a value that updates on the sidebar
("Needs response" → cleared), sourced from `pending_elicitations_count` going
`1 → 0` on `GET /v1/sessions`. Reproducing it requires killing the sub-agent's
runner (SIGTERM / exit 143) and restarting the server mid-journey, which the
standard web recorder tape cannot drive (it cannot kill a runner and restart the
server inside one recording). The e2e test above drives the full real
server/runner-restart sequence and asserts on that exact badge source: parked
count=1 (badge shows "Needs response") → after answering the restarted
offline session, count=0 (badge clears); on the unfixed tree the answer is a
no-op and the count stays 1.

## Type of change

- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] UI / frontend change
- [ ] Refactor / chore
- [ ] Docs
- [ ] Test / CI
- [ ] Breaking change

## Test coverage

## Coverage notes

Automated coverage above was rerun on the current PR head. The reproduction is a
server/HTTP-level sequence (runner death + server restart + answer); the
end-to-end test asserts on the same `pending_elicitations_count` value the SPA
sidebar badge renders from, which is why no browser recording accompanies it.

- [ ] No — no noteworthy user-facing change.
- [x] Yes — include the entry in the Changelog section.

when the sub-agent's runner had died and the app restarted before you answered.
